newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway billionaire ups stake in Storebrand.
newsitem.headline: Norway billionaire ups stake in Storebrand.

text.p: Norwegian billionaire entrepreneur Kjell Inge Roekke has acquired additional shares in Storebrand ASA and now own a 10 percent stake in Norway's largest insurance group, the Oslo bourse said on Thursday.
In March Roekke announced he had bought around six percent of ordinary Storebrand stock through his private Liberian-registered company Ivory Enterprises Corp.

Storebrand and Norway's second largest bank Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse ASA announced on Wednesday that they planned to merge to form the country's largest financial institution with a market capitalisation of 26 billion crowns.
Roekke is the largest shareholder in Norwegian industrial holding company Aker RGI ASA.
At 1257 GMT, Storebrand's share price stood 0.70 crowns down at 46.80 crowns.
